tournament.name: July OCC - Qualifier B
tournament.description: OCC JULY SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - July 16th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline June 16th @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline June 15th) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. (Round of 8 Finals - July 23rd @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline July 21st @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
